title: Spirit of Life
definition: Spirit of Life is a biblical description of the Holy Spirit's work in giving spiritual life, freeing believers from sin's dominion, and assuring resurrection life in Christ.
summary: The Holy Spirit gives life in Christ and frees believers from the law of sin and death.
christFocus: Jesus gives life through the Spirit, and the Spirit applies the resurrection life of Christ to His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit is called the Spirit of life because He gives life where sin has brought death. He regenerates, renews, and brings believers into the life of Christ.

This life is not merely future. The Spirit frees believers from the ruling power of sin and enables them to walk in newness of life now.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people think Christianity is only moral improvement. This doctrine matters because sinners need new life, not just better habits.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Depend on the Spirit for real life and renewal. Do not return to the old slavery of sin when Christ has given life by the Spirit.
